notes: NATO, neutral and enemy totals from zero to the int16 limits, including negative totals and a zero 16-bit sum. Pie, rectangle, frame, widget lookup and widget text callees are logging stubs; sprintf logs the format and the double and writes a queued zero-padded string, and the decimal reader 0x9d55d logs the text and its end pointer and returns a queued double. Truncation and strcat run as original code.
